name: DHS order bars DeepSeek products from federal civilian agencies
title: Notice of Order Regarding Exclusion and Removal of DeepSeek Products From Federal Civilian Executive Branch Information Technology Systems and Procurements
headline: DHS order bars DeepSeek products from federal civilian agencies
lede: Federal civilian agencies can no longer buy DeepSeek IT products and services and must remove them, along with third-party products built using DeepSeek implementations, from their systems.
